programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen är i Distrikt 13 efter att ha krossat spelen för all framtid.

programme.title: Lucky Number Slevin
programme.desc: Slevin identifieras som en man han inte är och hamnar i kläm mellan två rivaliserande bossar.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: The journey leads from the Norwegian Vesterålen to Chad, the Aeolian Islands and the Polish Giant Mountains. As different as the landscapes and cultures may be, all people are united in their love for their children and their desire to give something to tomorrow's generation.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: What ideas are people on the 15th meridian east developing to shape the future and leave tomorrow's generations a home worth living in? This consequence leads us to four future designers. From the barren Namib Desert to the glacier worlds of Spitsbergen, Sicily and the Croatian Mediterranean.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Dust And Stripes
programme.desc: In a never-ending quest for grass and water, the striped herds undertake an annual epic trek across the vast lunar landscape of the Kalahari’s Makgadikgadi Pans. Most of the year, the Makgadikgadi is an inhospitable wasteland of windswept, salt-encrusted pans. For the area’s water-dependent zebra, the Boteti River on the western edge of the pans is a dry-season lifeline. However, it is also a death trap, with lions waiting in ambush and crocodiles lurking in dark riverside caves.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Montenegro - From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.desc: The moon disappears behind the horizon and the stage is set for a new day in the Alps of Berchtesgaden.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.sub-title: Wild Bavaria - In The Shadow of the Watzmann.
programme.desc: Mighty and mysterious, King Watzmann sits above Germany's only alpine national park.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, Florida - The Sunshine State
programme.desc: Nowhere is the American way of life as relaxed as on Florida's beaches. The Keys, a chain of islands at the far southern end of the state, reveal a more laid-back side of the USA. But all of Florida amazes -- with secluded beaches, unspoiled nature, and the legacy of the early European settlers.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The City and the Sea
programme.desc: The journey up the coast continues through Delaware to suburban New Jersey, and onwards into the heart of Manhattan. In Delaware, famous as a corporate tax haven, we visit a winery. In New York City we zip around with a bicycle courier and then head out to Long Island for oysters.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The Heart of New England
programme.desc: From New York, the journey up the coast leads into the heart of New England. We visit Yale; spend some time in the 19th century mansions at Newport, RI; tour the coastal fishing and vacation towns of Massachusetts, and then meet a modern entrepreneur in Boston and see her rooftop gardens.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.sub-title: Wild Baltic - Life on the Amber Coast
programme.desc: The first episode of this two-part nature documentary presents the natural beauty of the shifting sand dunes of the Curonian Spit, the romantic beaches of the Latvian Baltic Sea and the island worlds of Estonia. Time and again, this deserted and almost untouched nature fascinates. In the winter, ringed seals give birth to their young on the pack ice. In the spring, Konik wild horse stallions fight fierce battles amongst themselves, while colourful European rollers fly through the dune forests. Lynxes wander through the coastal forests and in the orchid meadows turncoats and hoopoes find more than enough food. On the islands around Saaremaa in Estonia, grey seals hunt for fish. They share the archipelago with Europe’s largest tern, the Caspian tern.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.sub-title: Wild Baltic - Enchanted Forests and Moors
programme.desc: The wide, often untouched wilderness of the Baltic hinterland is home to many animals. More than 35 brown bears live in the primeval forests of Alutaguse. In the spring, the Soomaa National Park transforms into a huge lake. Europe's widest waterfall is located in Latvia. In the beginning of May, vimba bream follow the course of the River Venta. The hardly 5-centimetre-long fish have to overcome a 4-metre-long rock barrier in order to reach their spawning grounds.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Halsema Highway, situated on the island Luzon, leads right through the Philippine jungle with its frequent fog and heavy rainfalls. Every trip on this so-called road is an adventure and highly dangerous. We accompany a bus driver and a taxi driver on their challenging trip across the mountains.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Canadian ice roads exist only for a few months in the winter when the ice is thick enough. The only time of the year when goods can be transported up to Northern Manitoba. We accompany the truckers Vlad and Hugh as well as the aboriginal Canadian Scott with his pick-up on their long journey to a village called God’s Lake. A risky trip in icy temperatures, sometimes even below - 60 degrees Celcius. The men are in constant danger of getting stuck and need to forget everything they ever learnt about driving on a highway in order to arrive safely.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yellowstone National Park is an American national park located in the western United States, largely in the northwest corner of Wyoming and extending into Montana, and Idaho. It was established by the U.S. Congress and signed into law by President Ulysses S. Grant on March 1, 1872. Yellowstone was the first national park in the U.S. and is also widely held to be the first national park in the world. The park is known for its wildlife and its many geothermal features, especially Old Faithful geyser, one of its most popular. While it represents many types of biomes, the subalpine forest is the most abundant. It is part of the South Central Rockies forests ecoregion.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: America's National Parks - Great Smoky Mountains
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: North America’s National Parks are world famous and their breathtaking landscapes fascinate millions of visitors. This spectacular series will show you what happens beyond the lookouts. Everglades National Park is an American national park that protects the southern twenty percent of the original Everglades in Florida. The park is the largest tropical wilderness in the United States, and the largest wilderness of any kind east of the Mississippi River. An average of one million people visit the park each year. Everglades is the third-largest national park in the contiguous United States after Death Valley and Yellowstone. UNESCO declared the Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve in 1976, and listed the park as a World Heritage Site in 1979, while the Ramsar Convention included the park on its list of Wetlands of International Importance in 1987. Everglades is one of only three locations in the world to appear on all three lists.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: Darkwoods - Where Nature Survives
programme.desc: Half a century ago the German Duke Carl von Württemberg purchased a 55.000-hectare parcel of land in the Selkirk Mountains in British Columbia, Canada. He baptized his holdings after his native Black Forest, "Darkwoods", and managed the forests in the lonely region sustainably.

programme.title: mareTV: The Caribbean for explorers: St. Vincent and the Grenadines
programme.desc: Much more Caribbean than on the islands of St. Vincent and the Grenadines is hardly possible. Deserted beaches, uninhabited islands, lush vegetation, the 33 islands in total are dreamlike with extremely hospitable inhabitants. Miranda Phillips runs a laundry and water boat on Bequia. Every morning, the 32-year-old navigates from yacht to yacht with her small bright green service vehicle and is already expected by most skippers. Miranda promises radiantly fresh laundry, which she delivers again the same day. And so there is always something going on in her tiny laundrette in the harbour. It turns into a karaoke bar in the evening, because that is Miranda's great passion. Eban Olliver has many jobs at once. He is the lighthouse keeper of Kingstown. And that means a lot of responsibility in St. Vincent's biggest port city. Because Eban doesn't just change the light bulbs, he's a pilot dispatcher, harbour master and guard all in one person. First contact with ships is particularly important. Once he even saved the entire nation from an Ebola virus.

programme.title: mareTV: Martinique
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore difficult to navigate. The crew members hang over the water in breakneck fashion on long wooden poles. Just the job for Yole-boss Max' "problem kids": they not only learn complicated handling, but also team spirit.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Orphanage of Elephants - Nairobi Nationalpark
programme.desc: We follow the rescue of a baby elephant. Once rescued, it will be transported by plane to the breeding station and raised with love and commitment. In order to satisfy the little pachyderm’s urge to move while in the breeding station, there is sometimes an adorable football match between the animals.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Return of the Elephants - Tsavo-East-Nationalpark
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Return of the Elephants - Tsavo-East-Nationalpark
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Italy My Love
programme.desc: In ten coastal areas of Italy, we encounter people that have a very special relationship with their region. All of them love their country, their traditions and their work. We met with enthusiasts and hedonists that permitted us to take a glimpse into their everyday lives. Young Italians, who have rediscovered nature and its treasures. Others, that preserve the beauty, archaeologists that apply whole new methods, farmers that only cultivate that which the soil needs. Fishermen, who fish in the same way as it was done a century ago and tough, young men who play and dance the Tarantella. Dolphins, giant sea turtles and pink flamingos, which are researched, nursed back to health or simply observed. Cave explorers, sail makers and coffee specialists are also part of the big picture. Flying drone cameras provide birds-eye views and are an important element of the films. The results are spectacular images from completely different angles which provide us with landscape overviews and detailed insights, the likes of which have never been seen before.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In Provence
programme.desc: Its native fragrant flowers and aromatic herbs have made the Provence a brand known worldwide. The wealth of flora found in this region, between the French Alps and the Mediterranean, is unequalled among the French provinces. Around Sault, near Mont Ventoux, the valleys and high plains are carpeted with bright violet: In the hot climate of the South of France, lavender blooms and exudes its fragrance. Monastic healers have been using its aromatic medicinal oil since the Middle Ages. And today an entire industry is based on the trade with this fragrant flower. Yet the livelihood of Provençal lavender farmers is imperiled. In France’s major lavender-growing region, the “Plateau de Valensole”, our viewers encounter Gérard Blanc, who has been hit particularly hard. The lavender farmer lost sixty percent of his harvest to one tiny insect: the leafhopper. This insect has already destroyed half of the lavender acreage, bumping France from its market position as the world’s top producer of lavender oil. The film visits a resolute farmer who, not about to give up, is testing methods to fend off the voracious insect.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In India
programme.desc: In India, herbs play an everyday role hardly equalled anywhere in the world. From the tropical green south to the mountains of the northern Himalayas, herbs lend fragrance to joss sticks and soaps, and flavor to the cuisine. And, above all, herbs heal. Six thousand varieties of plants are used in India, and most are harvested in the wild – where they are becoming depleted. The ever rising need for herbal medicine for the subcontinent’s 1.3 billion inhabitants comes on top of the demand of its growing middle class for herbal-based cosmetics. As a result, certain herbs have become scarce, while others have already vanished entirely. Most of the herbs in India are harvested in the wild. The progress of first cultivation attempts is slow. In India, the rural population, especially, needs affordable, well-tolerated medicine – medicine based on herbs. In Kerala, the film shows a family operation that hand-produces botanical medicine for the local market. High up in the Himalayas, we observe a village healer at work. The science of Ayurvedic medicine is five thousand years old. Today, interest in the ancient healing art is surging, not only in India. In Delhi’s Old Town, the film visits a wholesaler who supplies the booming global herb market, and we take a look inside the laboratories of the largest manufacturer of Ayurvedic medicines in the world. In Kerala, we meet a doctor employed at a small Ayurveda clinic, and in Nordern India, we join a student of Tibetan medicine on a hike up into the mountains, where she prepares for an exam in herbology.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In Latin America
programme.desc: Healing effects, fragrance, and intense flavor – the benefits of herbs were discovered by the indigenous peoples of South America long before Spanish conquistadores subdued the continent. Even today, in the remote regions of South America, life without herbs is unthinkable. For many inhabitants, they provide the sole medicine. For more than two thousand years, this wisdom of the healing powers of nature has been passed down from generation to generation. In Bolivia, the film accompanies ethnobiologist Rainer Bussmann on one of his expeditions documenting which herbs the locals use against which illnesses. The German scientist has spent the last 15 years in the region, focussed on preserving this invaluable knowledge.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: As contrasting as the landscapes of the 15th meridian east, so different are its animal inhabitants. What are the living conditions like in the heat of the Namibian Damaraland, in Lusatia or on the coast of Norway? Which challenges do elephants, whales or kingfishers have to master together with their companions from north to south?

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: Almost 11000 kilometres lie between the northernmost and southernmost point of the 15th meridian east. Here you will find extreme landscapes such as the shimmering heat of Africa or the eternal cold of northern Scandinavia. Five people from Spitsbergen, Namibia, Slovenia, Germany and Poland dedicate their lives to environmental protection.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: This episode focuses on people from five countries who share a common passion: The production of their own food and food. What culinary treasures are hidden in the different regions, from Spitsbergen to Sweden, Austria, Poland and Chad?

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it’s a vital one for Burundi’s economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.sub-title: The Road To Death In The Andes
programme.desc: The Carretera de la muerte - the road to death- is one of the most dangerous roads in the world. Year after year many people die here. We accompany trucker Omar and his co-driver Jaime on their trip across the Andes, encountering cyclists, mountain bikers and coca-farmers on the way.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa, encountering pilgrims, mountain bikers and nomads on this dangerous journey.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world’s ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn’s house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts & Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver’s personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Olympic National Park is an American national park located in the State of Washington, on the Olympic Peninsula. The park has four regions: the Pacific coastline, alpine areas, the west side temperate rainforest and the forests of the drier east side. Within the park there are three distinct ecosystems which are subalpine forest and wildflower meadow, temperate forest, and the rugged Pacific coast. President Theodore Roosevelt originally designated Mount Olympus National Monument on 2 March 1909. The monument was redesignated as a national park by Congress and President Franklin Roosevelt on June 29, 1938. In 1976, Olympic National Park was designated by UNESCO as an International Biosphere Reserve, and in 1981 as a World Heritage Site. In 1988, Congress designated 95 percent of the park as the Olympic Wilderness.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: Wild Prairie Man
programme.desc: Located in the Northern Great Plains of Canada, Grasslands National Park has been a 20 year odyssey for wildlife photographer James R. Page. For James, critters are more interesting than people and he shares some of his iconic images and experiences from this endangered ecosystem. We showcase the parks wilderness that is dominated by prairie light and dark sky, the wildlife, prairie dogs, mesmerizing landscapes, and bisons. We immerse ourselves in the wild habitat of Grasslands National Park for over a year capturing some never before scenes in the Wild Prairie. James R. Page's connection to the land and the wildlife provides an unforgettable journey into the heart of this endangered ecosystem, while Park experts help us understand its complexity.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Wild Slovakia
programme.desc: Brown bears, wolves, lynx, eagles… where within the European Union are these carnivores still regular inhabitants? Where can you find mountainous regions that yet wait to be discovered by mass tourism?

programme.title: mareTV: Peru - Coast of the Incas
programme.desc: Dramatically, the coast plunges into the sea, the so-called Costa of Peru is a gigantic desert on the Pacific Ocean, 2,400 kilometers long. Rugged, bizarre, like from another star. Ancient cultures settled here, the Moche and the Chimú. Later the proud Inca, the self-proclaimed royal people of the Andes, ruled. In the small town of Huanchaco in northern Peru, the fishermen build a new boat every month: from reed. The small ships are called Caballito de Totora (reed horses), because the shape is reminiscent of a horse and the fishermen ride in it kneeling in the waves. About 2,000 years ago, the moche used it to go out to sea. Carlos Segura Azola is a descendant of the moche. He is currently building a "reed horse" again. But actually something completely different occupies him. Carlos has been afraid of the sea ever since his father drowned at work. The fisherman consults a Brucha, a witch. She tries to drive him out of panic at the Pacific with mysterious ceremonies. At some point Carlos' reed boat is finished and he has to get out to his nets again. In the south, in the port city of Pisco, there are hardly any private cars. Mototaxis on three wheels are the means of transport here. Every moto looks different, because the young drivers compete with each other. They constantly pimp out their tricycles with spoilers, mirrors and all kinds of decorations. Because if you stand out in the traffic jam, you get the most passengers. But nowhere else in Peru is road traffic as dense and chaotic as in the capital Lima. That's why Juan Ortiz goes daily with his Delta glider over the coastal road into the air. He is the flying reporter and reports live for the traffic news. And he is not alone with his aircraft. Dozens of paragliders float along the cliffs of Lima at any time of the day. The Pacific provides a constant upwind on the up to 160 meter high cliffs. Somewhere in the labyrinth of the metropolis of millions hundreds of believers trot to the beat of the music of a Jesus statue on the cross. A procession for the "Lord of Miracles", the brass band intones church songs. The music student Bruno Alvarado drags and plays the largest instrument, a sousaphone. Every day there are dozens of processions in Lima. Practical for Bruno, he finances his studies with the musical accompaniment. Away from the hustle and bustle of the big city, in the Paracas National Park, it is deserted. Luis Zapato runs a kiosk on a lonely beach amidst huge sand dunes. The kiosk has meanwhile developed into a gourmet temple, even the capital city dwellers flock here. Especially because of the scallops that Luis is the only licence holder to collect far and wide from the seabed. Inti Mar he called his beach snack, Inti is the sun god, Mar the sea. At Luis you literally eat like a sun god at the sea. This is only possible here, on the Inca coast.

programme.desc: From thousands of hopefuls, just two remain to battle it out on the catwalk. Who will Elle Macpherson crown as Britain & Ireland's Next Top Model?

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 1
programme.desc: The show returns for an eighth series with 20 contestants all competing to impress judges Elle Macpherson, Tyson Beckford, Whitney Port and Julien Macdonald to win a contract with Models 1.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 2
programme.desc: The remaining 17 contestants meet with the judges for one-on-one interviews and are scheduled to have a photo shoot with camels in the desert, but it gets canceled due to a sandstorm.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 3
programme.desc: The 13 contestants move into the model house and have a housewarming party, where they are visited by Cycle 7 winner Jade Thompson.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 4
programme.desc: The remaining 12 contestants receive makeovers at the Daniel Galvin salon and get their teeth whitened before being treated to a day out at a skating disco.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 5
programme.desc: The contestants go to the Hurlingham Academy and meet image consultant Vernon Francois for a challenge in which they decorate t-shirts and talk about their insecurities in a motivational speech for the school's students.

programme.desc: The contestants shoot a mock commercial for Alcatel, where they pretend to talk to their lover over the phone with a script written in French.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 7
programme.desc: The contestants meet TV presenter Laura Whitmore for a posing challenge in Carnaby Street under the pouring rain while passersby vote on their favorite contestants.

programme.desc: The remaining contestants take on a catwalk challenge for TRESemmé, walking on a plexiglass runway covered in water. Lisa is chosen as the best performer, winning a year’s worth of TRESemmé products and hair services at the Daniel Galvin salon.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 9
programme.desc: The contestants meet journalist Gordon Smart and participate in a press challenge where they write a 60-second skit regarding their opinions of the other contestants, which they later present in front of the camera.

programme.desc: Letitia, Lisa, and Roxanne receive a second set of makeovers. The contestants meet with Elle at Hyde Park, where they learn that the remaining five contestants will be traveling to Canada for the remainder of the competition.

programme.desc: Abbi och Ilana tar svampar och får en händelserik tripp.

programme.desc: Abbis mamma är på besök i stan, och Ilana försöker klara den hektiska arbetskulturen på Sushi Mambeaux medan hon hanterar sin årstidsbundna depression.

programme.title: Broad City: Witches
programme.desc: Abbi känner sig gammal när hon upptäcker ett grått hår. Ilana träffar en sexterapeut.

programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana, Jaime och Lincoln passar familjen Strands hus. Ilana och Lincoln definierar sin relation, och Abbi har en Bumbledejt med en man från förr.

programme.desc: En fin, ny väska ger Abbi självförtroende under arbetslösheten. Ilana och Jaimé får hantera en i New York City oundviklig mardröm.

programme.title: Broad City: Friendiversary
programme.desc: Tjejernas firande av 'kompisårsdagen' blir plötsligt farlig när de bevittnar nåt hemskt.

programme.desc: Abbi fyller 30. Abbi och Ilana reser genom hela Manhattan, och träffar både gamla och nya vänner.

programme.desc: Ilana hälsar på en gammal flamma för att få ut sin Bitcoinandel. Abbi går till en tvättomat för första gången och blir av med sin favorittröja.

programme.desc: Abbi blir inbjuden till ett fint konstevent på MoMA. Ilana och Lincoln stämmer av efter ett års förhållande.

programme.desc: Tjejerna träffar en släkting till Ilana, en överlevare från Förintelsen, och tar med honom på dragbrunch. Abbi testar en ny look.

programme.desc: Ilana rekryteras som hårmodell. Abbis nya kärlek påstår att hon inte är tillräckligt mogen.

programme.desc: Abbi och Ilana åker till 'Sleep No More', och Abbi försöker hitta rätt tillfälle att berätta nåt stort för Ilana.

programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana och Bevers säljer Abbis saker i New York City, Abbi får biljetter till Lil Wayne, och tjejerna gör en 'tripp'.

programme.desc: Chester och Kanicula har ett skämt-krig. Men vem visar sig vara sen ultimata skämtaren i Orlocks hushåll?

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Parförmedlaren
programme.desc: Darwin gillar en tjej i klassen så Gumball bestämmer sig för att leka Amor.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Betygen
programme.desc: Fröken Primat hittar ett av Gumballs gamla underkända prov och detta sänker snittbetyget. Till hennes förtjusning behöver Gumball nu gå om förskolan.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Dieten
programme.desc: Gumball och Darwin upptäcker att anledningen till att Richards diet inte fungerar är för att han är på 10 dieter och äter ett mål mat från varje diet.

programme.title: Gumballs härligt helgalna värld: Burgaren
programme.desc: Gumball och Darwin försöker hitta ett nyttigt middagsalternativ åt familjen, men ett ondskefullt matimperium har monopoliserat matindustrin.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Pilar och polare
programme.desc: Finn ställer upp i ett armborstmästerskap för att bevisa sin styrka, och Jake brottas med vetskapen om att Finn inte har talang för sporten.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Snobbkryp
programme.desc: Finn dras in i en insektsduell och måste snabbt lära sig bemästra de förnäma krypens språk och stil innan tävlingen börjar.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Fula ord
programme.desc: När Jake berättar att han grävt ner fula demonord i trädgården, måste Finn övertyga honom om att möta sina inre demoner – bokstavligt talat!

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Räddningsprinsessan
programme.desc: Finn och Jake måste stoppa Iskungen i hans jakt på en verklighetsfrånvänd ensidig kärlek med prinsessan som räddade honom.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Mani-pedikyr
programme.desc: Efter att ha besegrat Broder Blod, belönar Titans sig själva med en tur till nagelsalongen.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Krämig soppa
programme.desc: Titans är i Boston, och med hjälp av Deadman letar de efter en legendarisk skål med krämig soppa.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Avslöjandet – historien om Teen Titans
programme.desc: En titt bakom kulisserna på historien bakom Teen Titans Go!

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Aktivera
programme.desc: Mirakeltvillingarna lär Titans om vattenkonservering.

programme.title: Regular Show: De försvunna videobanden: Kafékrigen
programme.desc: Ett konkurrerande kafé öppnar i stan.

programme.title: Regular Show: De försvunna videobanden: Boba or Bo-Bust
programme.desc: Mordecai och Rigby måste sälja stora mängder boba.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Brorsorna
programme.desc: Darwin blir avundsjuk på Gumball och Pennys relation.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Mannen
programme.desc: Det är farmor Jojo´s födesledag och han har tagit med en oväntad gäst till middagen.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Pizzan
programme.desc: Här är familjen Watterson: Mamma, Pappa, Anais, Darwin och såklart Gumball! Han är en 12-årig katt med en talang för misslyckade äventyr.

programme.title: Kanicula: Chokladvampyrkaninen
programme.desc: När Kanicula äter en kakaoböna förvandlas han till choklad och jagas av godisgalna barn. Han har bara ett mål - att ta sig hem helskinnad.

programme.title: Kanicula: Legenden om lyckoamuletten
programme.desc: Gänget hittar en lyckoberlock som kan visa dem framtiden. I den ser de ett par monster som anfaller en äldre Nina. Hon kommer att hamna i trubbel!

programme.title: Kanicula: Prismafängelset
programme.desc: Kanicula, Chester och Harald hamnar i ett rymningssäkert fängelse efter att ha varit utklädda som vampyrer.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Skulden
programme.desc: Föräldrar- och lärarrådet på skolan i Elmore förbjuder tv-spel, så barnen måste försöka bevisa att tv-spel inte har dåligt inflytande

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Katastrofen
programme.desc: Rob får äntligen makten att förgöra hela Gumballs värld.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Reprisen
programme.desc: Sist vi såg Gumball tryckte han på spola-tillbaka-knappen på Robs fjärrkontroll. Den har tagit honom tillbaka till början av den ödesdigra dagen.

programme.title: Gumballs härligt helgalna värld: Cheerleadern
programme.desc: Gumball kämpar för att få med Richard i skolans cheerleadertrupp, och därmed få bukt med ett trauma som följt familjen genom generationerna.

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons: Grattis på fågelse-dan! / Spåmannen Daffy: Ny kärlek / Fjäderfä och Fritt fall
programme.desc: Pip firar sin födelsedag. Daffy som spåman friar till Pelle . Gråben sätter fjädrar på fötterna för att bli snabbare.

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons: Knäck katten / Daffy Stoppas av polisen - Båtförarbevis / Inte klot på bowling
programme.desc: Hubbe och Berra tar risker när de bryter sig in i i en ostbutik. Daffy blir stoppad av trafikpolisen. Pelle lär sin brorson att bowla

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons: Stenålders-knas / Jakttrofén
programme.desc: Grottankan Daffy och Forntids-Pelle har ett stenåldersäventyr. När Helmer går på jakt, belönas han med en trofé!

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons: Trädgårdstrubbel / Ta ut katten: Dörrskiva / Andas med Ankan
programme.desc: Petunia vill pyssla i trädgården, mn det blir bara problem. Yoga är avslappnande, om man inte har Daffy som nstruktör

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Super-Robin
programme.desc: Avundsjuk på de andra Titanernas krafter, vill Robin ha några egna.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Maktens torn
programme.desc: Cyborg pajar när han blir våt, så de andra plockar isär honom. När de inte vet hur de ska sätta ihop honom laddar de upp Cyborg i tornets huvuddator.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Bevingad kärlek
programme.desc: Beemo hjälper två pirriga insekter med kärleken, men när Finn och Jake lägger sig i flörtförsöken hotas krypens spirande ungdomskärlek.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Lite håla får man tåla
programme.desc: Finn tar med Jake till sin barndoms älskade fängelsehåla. När den visar sig ha förändrats, försöker Jake återskapa den besvikna Finns glada minnen.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Chefen
programme.desc: Pojkarna hjälper Rocky att få ett kontorsjobb så att hans pappa kan vara stolt över honom.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Knepet
programme.desc: Clayton är en notorisk lögnare, men Gumball upptäcker att han inte ljög om sina fantastiska kampsportstricks.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Lagen
programme.desc: Donut Cop visar Gumbal och Darwin att även ett litet brott bryter mot lagen.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Allergin
programme.desc: Gumball behöver hitta ett botemedel mot Darwins allergi innan han nyser bort Elmore från kartan.

programme.title: Gumballs härligt helgalna värld: Ändrat manus
programme.desc: Pojkarna är på väg att upptäcka sanningen om Elmore, men deras gamle ärkefiende bestämmer sig för att skriva om historien.

programme.title: Kanicula: Riddarugglan
programme.desc: När Kanicula inte kan beskydda Orlocks hyreshus mot övernaturliga krafter på egen hand, presenterar Kanicula sina vänner för Riddarugglan.

programme.title: Kanicula: Pipigt värre
programme.desc: När en elak vikings onda ande blir levande igen och tar över en pipande hundleksak, försöker den hämnas på Kanicula som spärrade in honom.

programme.title: Kanicula: Kaniculas son
programme.desc: När Chester påstår att en aubergine kommer att få Kanicula att lägga ett monsterägg bestämmer sig kaninen för att skoja med Chester.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Verkstaden, del 1
programme.desc: Titans brottsbekämpande vapen går sönder och de vänder sig till personalen på verkstaden för att få hjälp med att laga dem.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Verkstaden, del 2
programme.desc: Verkstadens personal pressas till det yttersta när de reparerar Titans utrustning, så att de kan stoppa Mad Mods planer på världsherravälde.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Philly
programme.desc: Under sitt besök i Philadelphia slår Titans sig samman med Bröderna Bacon för att stoppa William Penns framfart i staden.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Välj din väg
programme.desc: Raven, Cyborg och Robin hamnar i en bok och måste lita på att Beast Boy och Starfire gör de rätta valen för att komma ut igen.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Prinsessan Nickedocka
programme.desc: Iskungen blir förälskad i en vacker prinsessa.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Trolldrottningens son
programme.desc: Iskungen säger sig ha skaffat flickvän, och Finn och Jake tvingas hjälpa honom när han passar hennes minst sagt busiga son.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Spinofferna
programme.desc: I sin önskan att förgöra Gumball bjuder ärkefienden Rob på en blandning av action, humor och drama-serier som handlar om andra karaktärer än Gumball.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Förvandlingen
programme.desc: Animerad serie. Följ med katten Gumball och guldfisken Darwin på äventyr!

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Förståelsen
programme.desc: Gumball och Darwin hamnar i trubbel när de gör allt som skolans nya elev säger. Sanningen är att de inte förstår ett ord av vad Peter Pepperoni säger.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Annonsen
programme.desc: För att klara månaden tvingas Wattersons hyra ut sitt hus. Men eftersom de inte har nån annanstans att bo bestämmer de sig för att stanna kvar i smyg.

programme.title: Gumballs härligt helgalna värld: Burgaren
programme.desc: Gumball och Darwin försöker hitta ett nyttigt middagsalternativ åt familjen, men ett ondskefullt matimperium har monopoliserat matindustrin.

programme.title: Regular Show: Äggcellent
programme.desc: Mordecai vill vinna en hatt åt Rigby genom att äta en jättestor omelett.

programme.title: Regular Show: Magmodellen
programme.desc: Muskelknutten vill få mer uppskattning i parken så han hotar att sluta och ta ett jobb som en magmodell.

programme.title: Regular Show: De försvunna videobanden: Städa vardagsrummet
programme.desc: Ett hemligt uppdrag måste slutföras innan vardagsrummet kan städas.

programme.title: Regular Show: De försvunna videobanden: Kreativ blockering
programme.desc: Mordecai blir upprörd över någon som han brukade sitta barnvakt åt.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Gods och tillgjordhet
programme.desc: Robin deltar vid Wayne-godsetss bal, för att bli arvinge till godset, men kommer de andra Titans förstöra hans chanser.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Magisk trans-oceansk kryssning
programme.desc: Det är kul ute till havs, när Titans njuter av en kryssning fylld med farliga uppdrag, snabba bilar och utomjordingsattacker.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Batmans födelsedagspresent
programme.desc: Titans gör Robin sällskap när han åker för att överlämna en födelsedagspresent till Batman, men de avleds under resans gång.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Fula ord
programme.desc: När Jake berättar att han grävt ner fula demonord i trädgården, måste Finn övertyga honom om att möta sina inre demoner – bokstavligt talat!

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Räddningsprinsessan
programme.desc: Finn och Jake måste stoppa Iskungen i hans jakt på en verklighetsfrånvänd ensidig kärlek med prinsessan som räddade honom.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Gränsen
programme.desc: Finn och Jake måste riskera allt för att alla drömmar ska slå in i mitten av en magisk önskeuppfyllande labyrint.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Het signatur
programme.desc: Marceline jäklas med Finn och Jake och säger att de är vampyrer, men kanske har skämtet gått för långt.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Uppenbarelsen
programme.desc: När Gumball och Darwin upptäcker ett manifest fyllt med ondska på Alans minnessticka bestämmer de sig för att stoppa hans plan om världsherravälde.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Valen
programme.desc: Nicole minns dagen då hon först träffade Rickard och tänker på alla val hon kunde gjort annorlunda.

programme.title: Kurage, den hariga hunden: Det Magiska Trädet/Roboten Robert
programme.desc: Kurage beskyddar Märtas magiska önsketräd från att huggas ned. / En stridsrobot förvandlar gänget till sina slavar.

programme.title: Kurage, den hariga hunden: Shirleys Förbannelse/Kurage I Den Stinkande Storstan
programme.desc: Kurage hittar en låda nedgrävd i trädgården. / Kurage tvingas leverera ett paket från en ondskefull kackerlacka.

programme.title: Gumballs härligt helgalna värld: Astrologiskt
programme.desc: Gumball och Penny måste hålla ihop till slutet av skoldagen och visa att de är ämnade för varandra, trots en astrologisk förutsägelse från Herr Liten.

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: James Harper on entinen erikoisjoukkojen sotilas, joka armeijasta erotuksen jälkeen värväytyy puolustusalan yritykseen suorittamaan salaisia operaatioita puolustusministeriölle. Hän saa tehtäväkseen tarkkailla Lähi-idästä kotoisin olevaa tutkijaa Saksassa. Chris Pinen tähdittämä toimintatrilleri on ruotsalaisohjaaja Tarik Salehin (The Nile Hilton Incident) ensimmäinen englanninkielinen elokuva.

programme.title: Greenland
programme.desc: Katastrofi-toimintatrilleri, jossa maapalloon uhkaa iskeä komeetta. Atlantassa tapaamme insinööri John Garryn, joka yhdessä vaimonsa Allisonin ja poikansa Nathanin kanssa kamppailee paetakseen ja jäädäkseen eloon nähdessään tulevan tuhon laajuuden.

programme.title: Beck: Tuhkattu
programme.desc: Beck-ryhmä saa tutkittavakseen tapauksen, jossa pastori on kuollut Helluntaikirkon mailla tapahtuneessa tuhopoltossa. Rikospaikalle saapuvalle Alexille tapauksesta tulee henkilökohtainen, kun hän tapaa henkilön menneisyydestään. Avuksi rikostutkintaan Alex värvää mentorinsa Martin Beckin.

programme.title: Vingar av glas
programme.desc: Nazli on syntynyt Irakissa ja varttunut Ruotsissa. Hän haluaa sulautua yhteiskuntaan ja kutsuu itseään Saraksi, mikä surettaa hänen isäänsä, joka haluaa hänet naimisiin irakilaisen kanssa. Pian Sara tapaa Johanin, mikä ei helpota tilannetta.

programme.title: Melukylän lapset
programme.desc: Astrid Lindgrenin kirjoihin perustuva ruotsalainen perhe-elokuva. Melukylä on pieni kylä Etelä-Ruotsissa ja siellä sijaitsee kolme tilaa. Välitalossa asuu Liisa ja hänen veljensä Saku ja Naku. Ylätalossa asuvat sisarukset Riitta ja Anna. Alatalossa taas Olli. Niin, ja tietenkin hänen pikkusiskonsa Kersti. Melukylässä eletään ihanaa keskikesää ja joka päivä on täynnä uusia seikkailuja!

programme.title: Paras Ruotsissa
programme.desc: Koko perheen elokuva kiusatusta 11-vuotiaasta Marcellosta, joka haluaa olla paras jossakin. Ystävyydestä luokan uuden tytön kanssa tulee käännekohta.

programme.title: Padelunelmia
programme.desc: Fabian pääsee hyvän padelelämän makuun railakkaissa juhlissa, mutta ensin poikien on kehitettävä osaamistaan vakoilemalla yhtä kilpailijoista. Ruotsalainen komediasarja Fabianista ja Hassesta, jotka päättävät muuttaa sulkkishallinsa padelhalliksi. Vaikkei heillä ole hajuakaan koko hommasta, he satsaavat projektiin lapsen innolla ja täynnä tulevaisuudenuskoa. Ruotsi 2023

programme.title: Tervetuloa Sjölyckaniin!
programme.desc: Klara ja katastrofiajatukset. Talohuolet saavat Klaran miettimään katastrofeja, ja Mats joutuu rehkimään joka suunnalla. Lily vie Abben tämän elämän ensimmäiselle mustikkaretkelle. Ruotsalainen komediasarja, johon on helppo samastua. Millaisia ongelmia voi syntyä, kun kolme sukupolvea kokoontuu kesäpaikkaan saaristoon? Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Solsidan - onnea onkimassa
programme.desc: Rikkoutunut posliinihiiri nostattaa kauhean hulabaloon Sundbergeillä, ja Alexin on saatettava asiat raiteilleen. Mickan ja Anna pohtivat, onko heistä tullut tylsiä, ja hakevat helpotusta kunnon känneillä. Fredde oppii vihdoin tuntemaan velipuolensa. Ruotsi 2025

programme.title: Käsi sydämellä
programme.desc: Kun Ava ja John kutsutaan pariskuntana juhlimaan Billien neljäkuukautispäivää, on selvää, että John ottaa heidän suhteensa vakavammin kuin Ava. Tukholmalaisella pariterapeutilla Avalla on yliluonnollinen kyky. Laittamalla käden ihmisen sydämelle hän näkee avainhetkiä tämän tulevasta rakkauselämästä. Itse hän on menettänyt uskon rakkauteen, kunnes eräänä päivänä näkee yllättävän näyn. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Pidätä henkeä!
programme.desc: Huono tunnelma. Tunnelma on huono Rubenin, Lon ja Wilman välillä. Mikä sopisi paremmin, tai huonommin, kuin lautanrakennuskilpailu? Yksin vesillä voi puhua kaikesta. Ruotsalaisessa nuorisosarjassa seuraamme kolmea teiniä, jotka tulevat aivan eri maailmoista ja tapaavat tapahtumarikkaalla kesäleirillä. Ruotsi 2019

programme.title: Agatha Christien Hjerson
programme.desc: Ravintolassa tehty murha on kopioitu kirjasta, jota ei ole vielä julkaistu. Vain viisi ihmistä tunsi käsikirjoituksen, yhden heistä on oltava murhaaja. Moderni ruotsalainen arvoitusdekkari, jonka innoittajina olivat Agatha Christien kertomukset. Ainutlaatuinen murhatutkija Sven Hjerson (Johan Rheborg) muodostaa yllättävän etsiväkaksikon omapäisen tv-tuottajan (Hanna Alström) kanssa. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: Tervetuloa Sjölyckaniin!
programme.desc: Klara on kateellinen Thomasin uudesta rakkaudesta. Kun hänen teini-idolinsa muuttaa Sjölyckaniin, hän saa tilaisuuden tehdä Rillen mustasukkaiseksi. programme.title: Happy fucking Pride
programme.desc: “Not Today, Satan”. Dilan ja Ari ovat haudanneet sotakirveen. Nina viettää yhä enemmän aikaa Ziggyn kanssa ja päättää erota Saschasta - helpommin sanottu kuin tehty. Tukholma kuplii odotuksia Pride-viikon alkaessa. Treffejä odottava pikkukaupungin poika Dilan, näennäisen itsevarma mutta satutettu huippumeklari Ari ja tämän juuri jätetty kaveri Nina navigoivat vauhdikkaiden kesäpäivien ja kuumien kesäöiden läpi. Ruotsi 2024

programme.desc: Saga lähtee Jennyn kanssa professori Paulan luo kysymään "varjotentistä". Kočí pyytää Sagaa mukaan Pariisiin. Jenny valehtelee äidilleen Uppsalasta. 20-vuotias Jenny jättää Eskilstunan lukeakseen psykologiksi Uppsalassa. Opiskelijakämpässä hän tapaa karismaattiset klubittajat Sagan ja Oliverin, jotka jo ensimmäisenä iltana houkuttelevat Jennyn tekemään päätöksen, jolla on tuhoisat seuraukset... Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Morran ja Tobias

programme.title: Bäckström
programme.desc: Vanha venäläinen kultainen soittorasia, joka esittää satuhahmo Pinocchiota ja on 300 miljoonan kruunun arvoinen, näyttää olevan murhan motiivi. Ruotsalainen rikosdraama perustuu Leif G.W. Perssonin suosittuihin kirjoihin ristiriitaisesta ja omahyväisestä murhatutkijasta Evert Bäckströmistä, joka ratkoo rikoksia omintakeisella tyylillään. Ruotsi 2020

programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: Bex tiimeineen jäljittää vankilasta paennutta vaarallista Xander Waxia, jolla on taipumus myrkyttää uhrinsa äkkiarvaamatta. Samaan aikaan komentokeskuksen tiimin sietokyky venytetään äärirajoilleen. Yhdysvallat 2025

programme.title: Shelby Oaks
programme.desc: Riley ystävineen pitää The Paranormal Paranoids -nimistä YouTube-kanavaa, jossa tutkitaan yliluonnollisia mysteerejä. Yhden tutkimusretken aikana hän katoaa jäljettömiin ja muut ryhmän jäsenet löydetään kuolleina. Rileyn sisar Mia kieltäytyy luopumasta etsinnöistä ja suuntaa 12 vuotta myöhemmin hylättyyn Shelby Oaksiin. Kaupunkiin kätkeytyy karmiva salaisuus, jonka olisi pitänyt pysyä haudattuna.

programme.title: Hei me rokataan!
programme.desc: Kaikkien aikojen hauskimmaksi komediaksikin tituleerattu kasariklassikko seuraa kuvitteellista rock-yhtyettä kiertue-elämän ylä- ja alamäissä. Bändiä piinaavat niin vaihtuvat rumpalit kuin laskevat lipunmyynnit sekä raivoisat riidat egojen törmätessä takahuoneiden syövereissä. Oletko valmis vääntämään nupin yhteentoista?

programme.title: Tiedän mitä teit viime kesänä
programme.desc: Eräänä kesäyönä joukko nuoria ajaa vahingossa autollaan kalastajan päälle. Kun he eivät saa häntä elvytettyä, he luulevat tämän kuolleen ja heittävät paniikissa ruumiin mereen. Seuraavana kesänä he alkavat saada outoja kirjeitä, joissa lukee: ”Tiedän, mitä teit viime kesänä.” Pian heitä vainoaa mies sadetakissa ja terävä koukku kädessään. Klassinen 90‑luvun kauhuelokuva.

programme.title: Syyttömänä vankilassa
programme.desc: Conny on kemianopettaja, joka aivan syyttä vedetään huumejuttuun ja tuomitaan vankilaan. Siellä hän oppii tuntemaan ammattirikollisia, jotka hoitavat salaisen tunnelin kautta hämäräbisneksiä. Conny pakotetaan heidän apurikseen.

programme.title: Syyttömänä vankilassa
programme.desc: Conny on kemianopettaja, joka aivan syyttä vedetään huumejuttuun ja tuomitaan vankilaan. Siellä hän oppii tuntemaan ammattirikollisia, jotka hoitavat salaisen tunnelin kautta hämäräbisneksiä. Conny pakotetaan heidän apurikseen.

programme.title: Bert - viimeinen viaton
programme.desc: Bertiä koetellaan. Hän on juuri aloittanut yhdeksännen luokan ja ajattelee tyttöjä koko ajan niin kuin useimmat pojat hänen iässään. Elämä vaikeutuu. Kaikki paitsi hän seurustelevat jo ja ovat luultavasti tehneet SITÄ satoja kertoja. Ainoa mahdollisuus päästä eroon viimeisen neitsyen taakasta on Victoria - hän on ihastuttava pieni olento, joka laskeutuu Bertin kotikaupunkiin itse pääkaupungista. Victoria kuitenkin rakastuu Carl-Philipiin, imelänkauniiseen vaaleaverikköön jolla on pitkä aaltoileva tukka.

programme.title: Veljeni Leijonamieli
programme.desc: Kuolemansa jälkeen Kaarle ja Joonatan Leijona tapaavat lyhyen maallisen elämänsä jälkeen Nangijalan taianomaisessa maassa. Kirsikkalaakson idyllistä elämää kuitenkin uhkaa julma ritari Tengil, joka on ottanut vallan Ruusulaaksossa.

programme.title: Padelunelmia
programme.desc: Jengi tähtää Bosse saunan varastoon ja Hasse saa Fabianissa aikaan odottamattoman reaktion. Padelkuningas yrittää tehdä vaikutuksen Nipapornin äitiin. Ruotsalainen komediasarja Fabianista ja Hassesta, jotka päättävät muuttaa sulkkishallinsa padelhalliksi. Vaikkei heillä ole hajuakaan koko hommasta, he satsaavat projektiin lapsen innolla ja täynnä tulevaisuudenuskoa. Ruotsi 2023

programme.title: Tervetuloa Sjölyckaniin!
programme.desc: Haaksirikkoiset. Kausi päättyy. Kaikki ovat riidoissa kaikkien kanssa, kun Abbe vie perheen veneretkelle. Tilanne pahenee, kun seurue juuttuu asumattomalle saarelle. Ruotsalainen komediasarja, johon on helppo samastua. Millaisia ongelmia voi syntyä, kun kolme sukupolvea kokoontuu kesäpaikkaan saaristoon? Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Solsidan - onnea onkimassa
programme.desc: Mickan ei ole tyytyväinen passikuvaansa eikä aio luovuttaa, ennen kuin se on täydellinen. Alexin on yritettävä olla asiakkaille miellyttävämpi saadakseen hyviä arvioita. Lievästi sanottuna monimutkainen koulualusta tuottaa Freddelle harmaita hiuksia. Ruotsi 2025

programme.title: Käsi sydämellä
programme.desc: Ava lähtee Johnin mukaan tämän perheen luo. Koko vierailun ajan häntä kuitenkin kiusaa näky, joka sai hänet epävarmaksi tulevaisuudesta Johnin kanssa. Tukholmalaisella pariterapeutilla Avalla on yliluonnollinen kyky. Laittamalla käden ihmisen sydämelle hän näkee avainhetkiä tämän tulevasta rakkauselämästä. Itse hän on menettänyt uskon rakkauteen, kunnes eräänä päivänä näkee yllättävän näyn. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Pidätä henkeä!
programme.desc: Eripura vaikuttaa totaaliselta. Nuoret istuvat omissa nurkissaan, kun ohjaajat ilmoittavat Hunger Games -kisasta. Kaikki kaikkia vastaan... Ruotsalaisessa nuorisosarjassa seuraamme kolmea teiniä, jotka tulevat aivan eri maailmoista ja tapaavat tapahtumarikkaalla kesäleirillä. Ruotsi 2019

programme.title: Agatha Christien Hjerson
programme.desc: Epäiltyjen määrä vähenee, kun selviää, että toinenkin murha liittyy kirjaan. Silmukka kiristyy, mutta murhaaja tuntuu aina olevan askeleen edellä. Moderni ruotsalainen arvoitusdekkari, jonka innoittajina olivat Agatha Christien kertomukset. Ainutlaatuinen murhatutkija Sven Hjerson (Johan Rheborg) muodostaa yllättävän etsiväkaksikon omapäisen tv-tuottajan (Hanna Alström) kanssa. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: Tervetuloa Sjölyckaniin!
programme.desc: Bernt rikkoo saaren kirjoittamattomia sääntöjä palkatessaan puolalaiset terassitöihin. Rille ja Klara lähtevät kahdestaan veneretkelle. Ruotsalainen komediasarja, johon on helppo samastua. Millaisia ongelmia voi syntyä, kun kolme sukupolvea kokoontuu kesäpaikkaan saaristoon? Ruotsi 2015

programme.title: Happy fucking Pride
programme.desc: “Fuck the Pain Away”. On viikon kohokohdan, kaikkien aikojen bileiden aika! Dilan haluaa jäädä kotiin, mutta hänet suostutellaan mukaan. Ninan ja Saschan suhde jännittyy. Tukholma kuplii odotuksia Pride-viikon alkaessa. Treffejä odottava pikkukaupungin poika Dilan, näennäisen itsevarma mutta satutettu huippumeklari Ari ja tämän juuri jätetty kaveri Nina navigoivat vauhdikkaiden kesäpäivien ja kuumien kesäöiden läpi. Ruotsi 2024

programme.title: Opiskelijakämppä
programme.desc: Flora ja Larsson yrittävät piristää Jennyä viemällä hänet bileisiin. Jenny saa sovinistisika Rickardin pöytänaapuriksi ja Oliver myy huumeita. 20-vuotias Jenny jättää Eskilstunan lukeakseen psykologiksi Uppsalassa. Opiskelijakämpässä hän tapaa karismaattiset klubittajat Sagan ja Oliverin, jotka jo ensimmäisenä iltana houkuttelevat Jennyn tekemään päätöksen, jolla on tuhoisat seuraukset... Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Morran ja Tobias
programme.desc: Tobias saa korvauksen vankilaan unohtamisesta. Morraninkin pitää osallistua jakamalla mainoksia. Autolla se sujuisi, mutta kumpikaan ei osaa ajaa. Ruotsalainen komediasarja Morranista ja tämän aikuisesta pojasta Tobiasista, jotka asuvat yhdessä ränsistyneessä talossa. Morran on saanut huomattavan tuen talon saneeraamiseen, mutta alituinen verkossa shoppailu näyttää aina olevan etusijalla. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Golden Boys
programme.desc: Uusi suunnitelma. Talousrikollinen Joachim Posener vapautuu vankilasta ja alkaa suunnitella uutta petosta hurjan serkkunsa kanssa. Brittiläisen bulvaani Lord Moynen avulla he ostavat merkittävän osake-erän sijoitusyhtiö Trustorilta. Mutta miten heillä on varaa maksaa? Ruotsi 2026

programme.title: Sokaistuneet
programme.desc: MMV. Bean tutkimusten mukaan vihje on oikea. Omantunnontuskista huolimatta hän kaivelee lisää, mutta innoissaan ylittää rajan. Peder tajuaa Bean petoksen. Carolina Neurathin todellisuuden innoittamaan romaaniin perustuva jännitysdraama nuoresta toimittajasta, joka ajautuu keskelle valtapelien, rahan ja salaisuuksien maailmaa. Tiivistunnelmaisen sarjan tähtinä Julia Ragnarsson ja Matias Varela. Ruotsi 2018

programme.title: Bäckström
programme.desc: Ankan alkaa kyseenalaistaa Bäckströmin rehellisyyttä. Erikssonilla oli suuri salaisuus, mikä tuo valoa murhailtaan. Olsson riskeeraa koko tutkinnan. Ruotsalainen rikosdraama perustuu Leif G.W. Perssonin suosittuihin kirjoihin ristiriitaisesta ja omahyväisestä murhatutkijasta Evert Bäckströmistä, joka ratkoo rikoksia omintakeisella tyylillään. Ruotsi 2020

programme.title: Murha Sandhamnissa
programme.desc: Kausi alkaa. Angelica, osa 1. Alexander ja Stenmark ottavat murtovarkaan kiinni rysän päältä, mutta tämä kieltäytyy puhumasta ennen kuin tapaa Noran. Tukholman saaristo ei ole niin rauhallinen kuin luulit. Aaltojen lyödessä kallioita vasten rikostarkastaja syyttäjä Nora Linde taistelee arvaamatonta pahuutta vastaan. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Hurmaava petturi
programme.desc: Lomaileva brittipariskunta joutuu mukaan kansainvälisiin hämärähommiin vakoojamestari John Le Carrén romaaniin perustuvassa trillerissä.

programme.title: Mr. Brooks
programme.desc: Earl on rakastava perheenisä ja arvostettu liikemies, jonka näennäisen idyllistä elämää varjostaa synkkä salaisuus. Hän muuttuu yön tunteina psykopaattiseksi sarjamurhaajaksi, minkä hän on onnistunut salaamaan jopa vaimoltaan. Sinniteltyään pari vuotta kaidalla polulla murhanhimon riivaama Earl antaa periksi alter egolleen Marshallille, joka maanittelee häntä tekemään vielä yhden murhakeikan.

programme.title: Ritsakauppias
programme.desc: Roland kasvaa 20-luvun Tukholmassa. Isä Fritjof on sosialisti ja äiti Zipa juutalainen. Vanhemmilla on tupakkakauppa, jossa isä käy poliittisia keskusteluja ja äiti myy laittomasti kondomeja, joista Roland tekee ritsoja ja myy niitä.

programme.title: Miss Sweden
programme.desc: Ruotsalainen nuorisodraama 19-vuotiaasta Moasta, joka löytää vain vääriä poikia.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 7
programme.desc: Hon är tillbaka! Den krävande Kitty Carter kommer till Valley Ranch för att lära ut dansteknik till de skraja DCC-dansarna. Sen tar Charlotte Jones Anderson de förundrade hejaklacksledarna på en privat rundtur i nya Cowboys Stadium.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 8
programme.desc: Kelli och Judy är tvungna att fatta svåra val som är rättvisa, men ändå beklagansvärda. Det här är sista chansen för träningslägerkandidaterna - det är bara två danslektioner kvar innan de sista skickas hem.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 1
programme.desc: För första gången hålls uttagningarna till Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders i den magnifika Cowboys Stadium i Arlington i Texas. Över 600 aspiranter med drömmar om att komma med i 2010-2011 års DCC-trupp anländer före gryningen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 2
programme.desc: De 47 nya tjejerna som tog sig till slututtagningen har haft två veckor på sig att träna, men kan de mäta sig med de 27 återvändande DCC-veteranerna?

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 3
programme.desc: DCC:s träningsläger börjar i kväll! Träningslägeraspiranterna anländer till Valley Ranch för första gången och får en chans att träffa sina idoler och mentorer - DCC-veteranerna.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 4
programme.desc: Det är andra veckan och snart ska de första skickas hem. Några utvalda veteraner skickas för att spela in ett inslag för "Good Morning America" och de får en livslång dröm att slå in för en lycklig kvinna.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 5
programme.desc: Vecka fyra av träningslägret börjar med att nybörjarna får deras DCC-makeover. Allt från hår och smink till solbrännor och tandblekning används för att göra kandidaterna DCC-redo.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 6
programme.desc: Träningslägret börjar lida mot sitt slut och det är dags för fotografering. Träningslägerkandidater och veteraner gör sig redo för närbilder i deras figursydda DCC-uniformer, med perfekt hår och smink.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 7
programme.desc: 2010 års trupp för Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders måste kungöras inom två dagar. Det är ingen hemlighet att det är sista chansen och pressen på träningslägerkandidaterna är enorm. Det är dags att visa framfötterna.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 8
programme.desc: Trettiofyra nya kandidater och veteraner klär sig inför det officiella truppfotot. Men det faktum att chefen och koreografen för Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders fortfarande inte har tillkännagett 2010 års trupp lägger sordin på stämningen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Audition Begins
programme.desc: Cowboys Stadium i Arlington i Texas är återigen skådeplats för uttagningarna till Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders. 500 kandidater som drömmer om en plats i teamet för säsongen 2011-2012 kommer till kvalet i gryningen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: On the Field
programme.desc: På den magnifika Cowboys Stadium äger DCC-uttagningen rum. Det blir spänt hos de 69 nya tjejerna när de 18 DCC-veteranerna ger sig in i kampen om en inbjudan till träningslägret.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Training Camp
programme.desc: DCC-träningslägret börjar ikväll på Valley Ranch! Stressen hos de nya kandidaterna är påtaglig när de försöker stuva om i sina scheman och säkra nya boenden i Dallas.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Famous Uniform
programme.desc: Efter två veckors träning förbereder sig Kelli och Judy inför första gallringen. Veckans repetitioner är viktiga för alla tjejer, de förväntas bemästra DCC:s världsberömda 'kick line' och 'jump split'.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Makeovers
programme.desc: Efter tre veckors träning kallas färskingarna in för sin DCC-'makeover'. De får en ny look, frisyrer och smink, och stöps i DCC-mallen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Cameo Photos
programme.desc: Kvällens repetition börjar med en knall när DCC:s tekniska chef Kitty Carter överraskar med ett besök på Valley Ranch.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Cameo Photos
programme.desc: Kvällens repetition börjar med en knall när DCC:s tekniska chef Kitty Carter överraskar med ett besök på Valley Ranch.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sibling Rivalry
programme.desc: In 1991, San Francisco pornographer Artie Mitchell was murdered in his home. His brother and business partner, who was found near the scene carrying a rifle, later confesses to shooting Artie.The question is whether the shooting was premeditated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pastoral Care
programme.desc: In 1981, New York correctional officer Donna Payant disappeared and was later found in a landfill. The medical examiner not only identified the cause of death, but also found an important clue.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bagging a Killer
programme.desc: In 1999, 9-year-old Valiree Jackson vanished on her way to school near Spokane. Her father, Brad Jackson, reported the disappearance and the entire community started searching for her abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Trouble
programme.desc: In 1995, when off-duty Maine State Trooper Vicky Gardner is attacked by Steven Fortin during a routine stop, it triggers a chain of events which jumpstart a stalled murder case in New Jersey.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cats, Flies & Snapshots
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Lori Auker left her Pennsylvania home for work and never arrived, it took space-age technology, cat hairs and insects to pinpoint the woman's abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naked Justice
programme.desc: When Leann Fletcher is found dead, investigators use blood spatter analysis and forensic computing to find a motive for her murder: her husband, a prominent lawyer, was having an affair with judge Susan Chrzanowski.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treading Not So Lightly
programme.desc: By using techniques she saw on forensic science TV shows, a mother determines who was responsible for the accident that permanently injured her 4-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shopping Spree
programme.desc: When a woman and her daughter didn't return home from shopping, her husband directed police to a nearby mall. The child's body was found, but there was no sign of the wife.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Forever Hold Your Peace
programme.desc: When Chris Ochoa confessed to the 1988 rape and murder of Nancy DePriest, the case was closed. 8 years later, Achim Marino confessed to the same crime. Can DNA evidence identify the real perpetrator?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Reel Danger
programme.desc: When two boys are brutally attacked, investigators rely on evidence fished out of a nearby pond. It became the first case where diatom analysis was used to place a suspect at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Who's Your Daddy
programme.desc: In 1988, the body of a young woman was discovered in an Ohio river. Most of the evidence had been washed away, but the victim's 6-year-old son unwittingly told investigators all they needed to know — without saying a word. The clue was in his genes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Alibi
programme.desc: In 1991, a high school girl vanished after attending a party. The prime suspect had two alibi witnesses for the night she disappeared. A solid alibi can often overcome circumstantial evidence, but forensic evidence is another matter.
